messages:
maria: Heads-up — ACME asked for delegated routing overrides so their SREs can pin traffic to a dedicated pool for a subset of endpoints. They want the ability to create/expire overrides without going through Redwood ops each time.
chris: Do they mean header-based pins (X-Org-Override) or a tenant-level sticky route?
maria: Header-based for specific paths and model routes. Example: pin /v1/generate?model=llama2 to dedicated pool A when X-Acme-Override=true. They want programmatic API access.
diane: Console UX question — if we expose a "Create override" flow, we need an approval step + visible audit trail. Enterprise feature, so only org admins should be able to delegate, not everyone.
ravi: Security flag: delegation expands blast radius. We should require Signed Override Tokens (JWT/HMAC) that encode org_id, override_id, expires_at, and approver. Also require an audit_id that ties to immutable logs. No permanent forever-on pins without explicit legal/CS sign-off.
maria: Agreed. Proposal idea: let org admins add a "delegated approver" role that can mint short-lived override tokens (12h default). Tokens minted via a new endpoint: POST /orgs/:org_id/overrides -> returns override_token.
chris: For fallback safety: overrides must include an explicit fallback route and a circuit-breaker. If dedicated pool reports unhealthy or quota exceeded, automatically fall back to default model route and emit a routed_override_failure metric.
diane: UX: show active overrides in Console -> Routes tab, with columns: created_by, delegated_to, expires_at, reason, audit_link. Allow quick revoke and force-expire. Also surface warnings if override increases expected cost.
ravi: Audit storage: append-only records shipped to internal audit S3 bucket and to the customer's audit_log webhook if configured. Retention policy 7 years for enterprise by default, configurable via contract. Also require reviewer email in metadata.
maria: Example API cURL for the minimal flow we discussed:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acme/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "matcher": "/v1/generate?model=llama2",
    "match_type": "path_and_query",
    "target_pool": "dedicated-acme-a",
    "expires_in_secs": 43200,
    "reason": "traffic migration window",
    "fallback": "default-pool",
    "delegated_to": "acme-sre@example.com"
  }'```
chris: Nice. On the implementation side: simplest is adding an Override object in our gateway service with fields: id, org_id, matcher, target, fallback, expires_at, status, audit_id. Evaluate using our existing routing table + priority weight so overrides don't bypass capacity checks.
diane: For Console approvals, we should support both manual approve + auto-approve for trusted orgs (config flag). Manual approvals should require 2FA for high-risk overrides.
ravi: Also add rate limits on how many active overrides per org (default 5) and per-route denylist to prevent overrides to experimental hardware types unless provisioned.
maria: Can we also attach a signed hmac header for emergency escape-hatch? e.g., X-RW-Override-Signature: hmac(override_id|expires_at). If someone calls with signature but gateway sees mismatch, reject and log.
chris: Yes — gateway verifies signature against org's stored key or our KMS-stored delegation key. We'll need a key rotation policy.
deploy-bot: playbook created: "enterprise-delegated-overrides-v1" (link: /playbooks/enterprise-delegated-overrides-v1) :robot_face:
maria: I'll draft a short spec with API schema, Console mocks, and the audit retention + legal checklist. Will ping @diane and @ravi for approvals.
diane: thanks — please include a sample UX flow for auto-approve toggles and the 2FA path.
ravi: Add security review checkbox and threat-model notes (privilege escalation, token leakage). I'll take the review once draft is in doc.
maria: OK assigning action items: maria -> spec draft, chris -> gateway implementation notes, diane -> console wireframes, ravi -> security checklist. Will target next Wed. :thumbsup:
